data.description: A great wyrm cloud dragon's breath weapon creates a cloud that persists in its cone shape for 1d4 rounds.  Treat this cloud as a fog cloud that deals electricity damage equal to half the dragon's breath weapon damage to any creature that ends its turn still within the cloud (Reflex save halves the damage - DC %1).
data.name: Cloud Breath
